reply.text:
Hi Luca,

thanks for reaching out. For a 24-month renewal we can offer CHF 148 per user / month on Sales Cloud Enterprise (today: CHF 156 per user / month). We cannot cap the annual uplift below 4%. On payment terms we may be flexible, subject to a credit review. The liability cap follows our standard terms and is not negotiable.

Best regards,
Anna Meyer
Salesforce

reply.text:
Hi Luca,

thank you. We can do CHF 144 per user / month for 24 months, with the annual uplift capped at 3%. Quarterly invoicing in advance is fine. On liability we can go to 18 months of fees, but not 24. Please confirm and we will send the revised Order Form.

Best regards,
Anna Meyer
Salesforce

emails.subject: Sales Cloud Enterprise — MSA + Order Form — renewal discussion — Helvetia Foods AG
emails.body:
Dear Salesforce team,

Our Sales Cloud Enterprise — MSA + Order Form agreement ends on 15 Jan 2027. Ahead of the 18 Oct 2026 notice date we would like to open the renewal discussion.

What we are looking for:
• Products and quantities: the same products and quantities as today (300 × Sales Cloud Enterprise, 60 × Sales Cloud CPQ, Premier Success Plan)
• Term: 12 months
• Commercials: a unit price about 10% below today’s CHF 156 per user / month
• Price increase: Cap at 3% or freeze for the renewed term.
• Auto-renewal: Shorten notice to 30 days; remove auto-renewal.

Could you send a revised proposal by 18 Sep 2026? We are keeping all options open until we receive it.

Kind regards,
Marta Keller
Procurement, Helvetia Foods AG

emails.subject: Re: Sales Cloud Enterprise — MSA + Order Form — counter-proposal
emails.body:
Dear Salesforce team,

Thank you for your proposal. We can move forward on the following basis:
• Unit price: CHF 144 per user / month for a 24-month term
• Uplift: capped at 3% (you offered 4%)
• Payment terms: quarterly in advance. Please clarify the credit-review conditions you mentioned
• Limitation of liability: we ask for 24 months of fees

If this works for you, please confirm in writing and send the revised Order Form.

Kind regards,
Marta Keller
Procurement, Helvetia Foods AG

emails.subject: eSignature Business Pro — renewal discussion — Helvetia Foods AG
emails.body:
Dear DocuSign team,

Our eSignature Business Pro agreement ends on 31 Oct 2026. Ahead of the 02 Oct 2026 notice date we would like to open the renewal discussion.

What we are looking for:
• Products and quantities: the same products and quantities as today (60 × eSignature Business Pro, Envelope allowance, Premier Support)
• Term: 12 months
• Commercials: a revised price proposal
• Auto-renewal: Give notice by 02 Oct 2026; re-sign on the smaller plan.
• Price increase: Freeze for the renewed term.

Could you send a revised proposal by 18 Sep 2026? We are keeping all options open until we receive it.

Kind regards,
Marta Keller
Procurement, Helvetia Foods AG

emails.subject: Re: eSignature Business Pro — counter-proposal
emails.body:
Dear DocuSign team,

Thank you for your proposal. We can move forward on the following basis:
• Unit price: CHF 47 per seat / month for a 12-month term
• Uplift: capped at 3% (you offered 4%)
• Payment terms: quarterly in advance. Please clarify the credit-review conditions you mentioned
• Limitation of liability: we ask for 24 months of fees

If this works for you, please confirm in writing and send the revised Order Form.

Kind regards,
Marta Keller
Procurement, Helvetia Foods AG

emails.subject: Enterprise Discount Program — renewal discussion — Helvetia Foods AG
emails.body:
Dear AWS team,

Our Enterprise Discount Program agreement ends on 31 Aug 2027. Ahead of the 01 Jun 2027 notice date we would like to open the renewal discussion.

What we are looking for:
• Products and quantities: the same products and quantities as today (EC2 + RDS committed usage, S3 + data transfer, Enterprise Support)
• Term: 24 months
• Commercials: a revised price proposal
• Commit shortfall: Allow a one-year carry-forward of up to 15%.

Could you send a revised proposal by 18 Sep 2026? We are keeping all options open until we receive it.

Kind regards,
Marta Keller
Procurement, Helvetia Foods AG

emails.subject: Re: Enterprise Discount Program — counter-proposal
emails.body:
Dear AWS team,

Thank you for your proposal. We can move forward on the following basis:
• Unit price: CHF 1,661,400 / yr for a 24-month term
• Uplift: capped at 3% (you offered 4%)
• Payment terms: quarterly in advance. Please clarify the credit-review conditions you mentioned
• Limitation of liability: we ask for 24 months of fees

If this works for you, please confirm in writing and send the revised Order Form.

Kind regards,
Marta Keller
Procurement, Helvetia Foods AG

emails.subject: Enterprise Discount Program — revised Order Form for signature
emails.body:
Dear AWS team,

Thank you for confirming. Please send the revised Order Form / amendment reflecting what we agreed:
• Quantities: unchanged
• Unit price: CHF 1,661,400 / yr
• Term: 24 months
• Uplift: capped at 0%
• Payment: quarterly in advance
• Limitation of liability: 18 months of fees

We will review it and come back before signature.

Kind regards,
Marta Keller
Procurement, Helvetia Foods AG

emails.subject: Request for proposal — electronic signature solution — Helvetia Foods AG
emails.body:
Dear Adobe Sign team,

Helvetia Foods AG is looking for an electronic signature solution from 01 Nov 2026. We ask you to answer on functions, not on product names.

Functions we need:
• Electronic signature with audit trail
• Templates and bulk send
• API and ERP integration
• EU data residency
• 99.9% uptime SLA
• SSO with Entra ID

Sizing: 60 seats / month.

For each function please tell us how your product covers it, and send your offer with pricing, term, migration plan and support model by 22 Sep 2026.

Kind regards,
Marta Keller
Procurement, Helvetia Foods AG

emails.subject: Notice of non-renewal — eSignature Business Pro — Helvetia Foods AG
emails.body:
Dear DocuSign team,

In accordance with the renewal clause of our agreement, Helvetia Foods AG gives written notice that it does not intend to renew eSignature Business Pro beyond the current term ending 31 Oct 2026.

This notice is sent on 08 Sep 2026, ahead of the 02 Oct 2026 deadline. Please confirm receipt in writing and share the offboarding and data-return steps set out in the agreement.

Kind regards,
Marta Keller
Procurement, Helvetia Foods AG

emails.body:
Dear Microsoft team,

In accordance with the renewal clause of our agreement, Helvetia Foods AG gives written notice that it does not intend to renew Enterprise Agreement · M365 E5 beyond the current term ending 30 Jun 2027.

This notice is sent on 08 Sep 2026, ahead of the 31 Mar 2027 deadline. Please confirm receipt in writing and share the offboarding and data-return steps set out in the agreement.

Please also confirm the SLA schedule in writing.

Please also confirm the SLA schedule in writing.

Kind regards,
Luca Lamalfa
Procurement, Helvetia Foods AG

emails.subject: Enterprise Discount Program — renewal discussion — Helvetia Foods AG
emails.body:
Dear AWS team,

Our Enterprise Discount Program agreement ends on 31 Aug 2027. Ahead of the 01 Jun 2027 notice date we would like to open the renewal discussion.

What we are looking for:
• Products and quantities: a reduction of quantities (details to follow)
• Term: 12 months
• Commercials: a unit price about 5% below today’s CHF 1,800,000 / yr
• Commit shortfall: Allow a one-year carry-forward of up to 15%.

Could you send a revised proposal by 18 Sep 2026? We are keeping all options open until we receive it.

Kind regards,
Marta Keller
Procurement, Helvetia Foods AG

emails.subject: Re: Enterprise Discount Program — renewal discussion — follow-up
emails.body:
Dear AWS team,

Following up on our message of 08 Sep about the renewal of Enterprise Discount Program. We have not registered a reply on our side yet. Could you let us know when we can expect your proposal? Our notice date under the agreement is 01 Jun 2027.

Kind regards,
Marta Keller
Procurement, Helvetia Foods AG

emails.subject: Re: Enterprise Discount Program — counter-proposal
emails.body:
Dear AWS team,

Thank you for your proposal. We can move forward on the following basis:
• Unit price: CHF 1,661,400 / yr for a 24-month term, with an exit option at month 12
• Uplift: capped at 3% (you offered 4%)
• Payment terms: quarterly in advance. Please clarify the credit-review conditions you mentioned
• Limitation of liability: we ask for 24 months of fees

If this works for you, please confirm in writing and send the revised Order Form.

Kind regards,
Marta Keller
Procurement, Helvetia Foods AG
